outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images (micrographs), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows normalized intensity data plotted as individual scatter points (red squares for euchromatin, green triangles for heterochromatin) over time, with fitted model curves overlaid. The underlying individual data points are directly visible as the scatter markers, including in the zoomed insets, satisfying the requirement.
